exercise.name: Cable Hip Abduction
library_steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the cuff on your far ankle.
Hold the machine for support and lift that leg out to the side.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.
exercise.one_line_summary: Standing on one leg side-on to a low pulley, a cuff on the far ankle and the near hand on the machine; the straight far leg lifts ~35 deg out to the side and returns. Hip abductors (gluteus medius / TFL on the side of the hip) do the work.

setup.target: Low pulley (~0.1 m), ankle cuff on the far ankle.
Near hand holds the machine; trunk upright; the standing leg straight.
setup.why: Library step; S1's standing hip abduction kept the pelvis level.

muscles.emg: Gluteus medius measured during standing hip abduction (S1); highest in hip abduction moves (S2: side-lying 81 % MVIC).
muscles.role: Lift the leg out to the side; what the exercise is for.
muscles.surface: Side of the hip below the pelvis rim.

muscles.emg: Gluteus maximus active in abduction moves (S2).

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Trunk tips toward the standing side to lift the leg higher.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Moves the work off the hip abductors.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Leg rolls out so the toes point at the ceiling.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Shifts the work to the hip flexors.

sources.citation: Bolgla LA, Uhl TL. 2005. Electromyographic analysis of hip rehabilitation exercises in a group of healthy subjects. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 35(8):487-494.
sources.what_it_gave: Gluteus medius EMG in 6 hip abduction exercises incl. standing hip abduction (non-weight-bearing leg) at 0 and 20 deg hip flexion.

sources.citation: Distefano LJ, Blackburn JT, Marshall SW, Padua DA. 2009. Gluteal muscle activation during common therapeutic exercises. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 39(7):532-540.
sources.what_it_gave: Gluteus medius highest in side-lying hip abduction (81 % MVIC); gluteus maximus lower in abduction moves than in single-leg squats/deadlifts.

clip_check.check: Start: working foot beside the standing foot
End: straight leg out to the side
Cuff on the far ankle, cable to the low pulley, clear of the standing leg
Near fist on the machine's grip; far fist on the hip
Standing foot flat on the floor
Abductors of the working leg strongest red
